mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair sitagliptin clearance and increase hypoglycemia risk through cumulative DPP-4 inhibition effects.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative antifungal therapy if possible; adjust sitagliptin dosing based on eGFR changes and monitor for hypoglycemia.
